For a dwarf wielder the text upgrades the weapon (greater striking, returning, thrown 30 feet) and adds 1d8 damage against giants; the record is a bare 1d8 bludgeoning hammer and nothing anywhere reacts to it. No legal field expresses ancestry-gated runes or damage dice conditioned on the target's creature type (strikeDamage has no target condition and would over-grant, situational bonuses take a flat modifier, not dice), so the honest delivery is a toggleable item mode carrying the wording.

mode.name: Dwarven Thrower (Dwarf Wielder)
mode.note: If you're a dwarf, this hammer functions as a +2 GREATER striking RETURNING warhammer with thrown 30 feet — set the greater striking rune and the thrown range yourself. Your attacks with it also deal 1d8 additional damage against giants; that rider only applies against giants, so it is not added to the strike line.

records.reason: Weapon rune: after the reaction the weapon deals an extra 1d8 of the triggering energy type UNTIL THE END OF YOUR NEXT TURN — an activated effect with a duration, i.e. a mode, and nothing currently exists (core.runes carries only id/slot/kind/level/price for this rune, and it is absent from situationalBonuses.ts and effect-backfill.json). Modes have no dice-valued modifier target, so the damage is carried as the mode's note (precedent: rune-sourced modes item-energy-adaptive and item-winged).

mode.name: Energized Weapon
mode.duration: until the end of your next turn
mode.note: The weapon is imbued with the energy type that triggered the reaction and deals an additional 1d8 damage of that type. Re-triggering doesn't stack: it replaces the type and restarts the duration.
